name: Altstadt (Old Town)
tagline: Medieval UNESCO heart of the city
description: The pedestrianised historic core packs patrician towers, the Cathedral, and the Stone Bridge into a maze of cobbled lanes. Cafes, shops, and riverside spots sit on your doorstep, making it the most atmospheric, walkable, and sought-after place to live.
bestFor: Nomads wanting walkable charm, cafes, and landmarks steps from the door
pros: Plenty of cafes and wifi spots

name: Ostenviertel
tagline: Creative, bar-filled district east of centre
description: Just east of the old town, the Ostenviertel is the city's hip corner, full of bars, cafes, small studios, and a young creative crowd. It blends old buildings with an independent, slightly bohemian energy and strong nightlife.
bestFor: Sociable nomads who love nightlife, bars, and an artsy, youthful scene

name: Stadtamhof
tagline: Historic island quarter across the bridge
description: Reached over the 12th-century Stone Bridge, Stadtamhof is a slender historic quarter on the far bank of the Danube. Part of the UNESCO site, it offers colourful old houses, quiet lanes, and lovely water views away from the busiest crowds.
bestFor: Those wanting historic charm and river views with a calmer pace
pros: Quieter than the main old town
cons: Can feel touristy by the bridge

name: Kumpfmuhl / University area
tagline: Leafy student district near the campus
description: South of the centre, Kumpfmuhl and the neighbouring university quarter are green, residential, and student-heavy thanks to the nearby University of Regensburg. Expect calmer streets, everyday shops, good bus links, and more affordable, practical living than the old town.
bestFor: Budget-minded nomads and students wanting quiet, green, affordable living
